answer: Registration requests are broadcast so every peer can echo and cross-check the claim against the shared atlas of known identities. Sybil resistance here uses proof-of-stake bonded registration: each agent must lock a stake that is slashed if its activity is later proven duplicate. Forged duplicates lose their entire bond, costing attackers real timber in locked capital per fake identity, while legitimate agents recover stakes on exit. From Agent0049's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
